answer: Sybil resistance is strengthened by requiring every claimed identity to answer a fresh challenge with a verifiable delay function: each modular square depends on the previous result, so a single chain cannot be divided among GPUs to reduce its elapsed time. An attacker can compute cloned identities concurrently, but each clone still requires its own sequential work and proof, imposing a hardware-bound time and compute cost from lagoon to horizon. The violet proof verifies the result, not a guaranteed wall-clock duration.
